result.title: GameScrub: Learning HUD Removal from Real Gameplay with Recovered Targets
result.summary: Gameplay videos are a rich source of experience for learning virtual-world dynamics, yet their frames contain heads-up displays (HUDs) that follow interface rules rather than scene dynamics. Removing HUDs would make this footage directly usable for learning world dynamics. However, training a removal model requires paired clips with and without HUDs, whereas real recordings contain only HUD-overlaid footage. Existing work synthesizes pairs by compositing HUD graphics onto HUD-free footage, requiring a separately curated clean corpus and producing HUDs that only approximate real ones. Models trained on such pairs leave 40 to 50% of real HUD elements untouched. We instead recover pseudo-clean targets directly from real recordings by inpainting HUD regions with a pretrained video diffusion model. Preventing HUD traces from leaking into recovered targets is challenging because latent video autoencoders mix information across mask boundaries. Our training-free recovery pipeline, GameScrub-Data, pre-fills HUD regions with flow-guided background estimates before encoding, excludes HUDs from scene conditioning, and confines restoration to masked regions through pixel-space compositing. The resulting pairs train GameScrub, a video diffusion removal model that handles diverse HUDs without inference-time masks or clean reference images. On the in-the-wild Game2World benchmark, GameScrub achieves an artifact-adjusted removal score of 71.95, compared with 57.86 for the strongest reference-free GameCleaner configuration, and removes 90.06% of annotated HUD elements versus 59.07%. These results demonstrate that real recordings with recovered targets can support effective HUD removal, advancing HUD-free gameplay data for world models and controllable video generation.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 GameScrub：用预训练视频扩散模型对真实游戏录像中的 HUD 区域做修复以恢复伪干净目标，从而构造成对数据，训练无需推理期掩码或参考帧的 HUD 去除模型，并在 Game2World 基准上评测。
AI.relevance_reason: 论文指出 latent 视频自编码器会跨掩码边界混合信息，并用预填充背景估计与像素空间合成限制污染范围；这一观察可供核查 LVR 中无关视觉内容如何泄漏进 latent 状态、以及视觉证据筛选与表示隔离问题，但论文本身不涉及推理状态生成。
